status: 기획용 플레이어·NPC 외형 시안. Unity 미적용

inputs.role: 정체성 참고 및 강한 단순화 대상
해상도·표현 복잡도 참고. 인물/UI/단색 팔레트 직접 복제 아님

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Input image 1 is our FIVE original actor identities. Input image 2 is a gameplay screenshot used ONLY as a low-resolution simplicity benchmark. Do not copy any character, UI, text or monochrome color scheme from input2.
RADICALLY REDRAW the five people from input1 as extremely tiny, flat, primitive GAME SPRITES with the simplicity of input2. This must be MUCH LESS DETAILED than input1. They should look like authentic16x24 pixel characters enlarged enormously, not polished pixel illustrations.
Exact result: FIVE characters in ONE ROW facing RIGHT, full bodies, ordered hooded swordsman / fox archer / purple-hat mage / barbarian / dwarf. Plain cream background #FFF2D8, wide3:1. Safe blank spacing, no labels, no text, no UI, no scenery. All five share the SAME large square pixel size.
BUILD EACH BODY FROM AROUND20–24 LOGICAL PIXELS IN HEIGHT, including head and feet. Only mage hat and barbarian can reach28. Head only5–6pixels across. Every hand is a single2x2pixel block. Feet simple3x2blocks. No visible fingers. Eyes single dark or gold squares. Weapons simple one-or-two-pixel shafts and solid silhouettes. This is a primitive early8-bit game, not a detailed16-bit RPG portrait.
ABSOLUTE NO SHADING. Use ONE FLAT COLOR for each material. NO shadows within cloth, NO highlight within skin, NO gradient anywhere. No extra border highlights. NO grain, texture, translucent edges or antialiasing. Every color region is a solid uniform flat fill. No belt buckles, straps, patches, armor seams, robe folds, boot laces, quiver feathers, beard hair, nails, muscles, ornaments. Only keep the 3key recognition shapes of each person.
Use ONLY the following fixed color swatches. No generated intermediate colors. Each person MAXIMUM6flat colors including outline:
outline #182B32; cream #F7E4B0; ochre #E4AA41; orange #D97935; teal #377A78; plum #745184; brown #795039; rust #AE4438; blue #355D82; mint #89C9AF; skin #DCAC79; steel #A1A9A2.
1SWORDSMAN: large simple CREAM hood with a NAVY face opening and ONE ochre eye, CREAM short shirt, NAVY limbs, OCHRE scarf drawn as a2pixel strip, simple brown boots. One SHORT steel sword held toward RIGHT from an ochre hilt. NO belt, NO gloves details, NO body shading, NO bell. Silhouette must be recognizably our little hooded On.
2FOX: ORANGE big ears and pointed fox muzzle, one CREAM tailtip, one large TEAL cloak colorblock, BROWN short bow on RIGHT and NAVY legs. Tail curves behind toLEFT. NO facial fur marks and no quiver.
3MAGE: PLUM triangular big hat as one flat shape, plain CREAM robe, BROWN staff onRIGHT with one MINT diamond, plain SKIN face with one dark square eye. NO hair strands, NO robe folds, NO belt.
4BARBARIAN: taller broad shoulders, SKIN square face and bare upper arms, NAVY flat hair, RUST scarf and sash as solid strips, BROWN vest/legs, one STEEL blunt greatsword down toRIGHT. NO muscle modeling, NO bracer detail, NO belts.
5DWARF: short broad body, OCHRE beard as a single stepped shape, BLUE apron as one flat rectangle, CREAM sleeves, BROWN boots/hammer handle, large STEEL hammerhead resting over RIGHT shoulder, NAVY outline/one eye. NO skin shading, NO beard strands, NO apron stitching.
Keep exactly5 identities and recognizable weapons, but remove every decorative or realistic detail. Increase logical pixel SIZE and reduce pixel COUNT. At thumbnail size each person should read almost like a colorful silhouette. If your result resembles the detailed reference sheet in shading or clothing detail, it is not simplified enough. The goal is ultra-simple colored game sprites comparable in abstraction to the gameplay reference.
priority: 플레이어와 NPC의 도트 밀도는 이 개정안을 우선한다. 기존 cast-concept.png는 초기 외형 참고로 보존한다.

productionTargets.bodyHeight: 일반 인물20~24 논리 픽셀, 바룬·리나 모자 포함최대28 목표
productionTargets.colorsPerCharacter: 최대6개 평면색 목표. 재질 내 그라데이션 금지
productionTargets.scaling: 몬스터와 동일한 논리 픽셀 밀도 및 정수 확대

limitations: 실제 생성 파일2172×724는 고정 논리격자 스프라이트 원본이 아니다.
첫 생성보다 내부 묘사는 크게 줄었지만 일부 면의 농담·가장자리 부드러움이 남아 정확한6색/고정격자 완성본으로 판정하지 않는다.
정식 투명 스프라이트·모션·프레임 피벗은 별도 제작 대상이다.
NPC 후보의 외형 기획이며 모든 NPC가 플레이어 캐릭터로 구현되었다는 뜻은 아니다.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: initial player and NPC low-resolution pixel-art concept sheet for a cheerful 2D fantasy action game.
Input image 1 is IDENTITY ONLY: preserve ONLY the five top-row characters' essential outfit colors, species, and weapons. Do not reproduce its fine-detail rendering. Exclude its bottom-row monsters.
Input image 2 is the STRICT STYLE REFERENCE: the new people must use the same very coarse, chunky square-pixel density as those monsters, or EVEN SIMPLER. Do not make people more detailed than the monster sheet.
Primary request: REDRAW ONLY FIVE full-body characters in one horizontal row, ordered left to right On, Tori, Rina, Barun, Doto. They all face RIGHT in side-view or near-side three-quarter combat-ready stance. Full head, feet, weapon tips, fox tail and hat visible with generous separation, no overlap, no cropped limbs. All feet stand on one invisible baseline.
Output composition: a wide landscape 3:1 sheet, approximately1536x512, plain flat warm cream #FFF2D8 background, no texture, no ground shadows, no panels, no letters, no names, no UI.
ABSOLUTE PRIORITY — REAL LOW-RES LOOK: imagine the entire sheet drawn on a192x64 logical pixel grid, then enlarged8x with nearest-neighbor. Body heights around24–32 logical pixels, NOT80 or150. One logical pixel must be a very large obvious SQUARE. Restrict every outline, face, hand, weapon and color region to that same large grid. One dark navy pixel outline. Only6–10 flat solid colors per character total, base and one shadow per material. No gradients, no antialiasing, no transparent edges, no grain, no texture, no fur strands, no hair strands, no clothing folds, no tiny embroidery, no glossy shading, no detailed fingers, no small buckles. Eyes are only one or two square pixels. Hands are one simple block wrapping the weapon handle.
Five character identities:
1. ON, the player: small compact human swordsman with a large CREAM hood and short CREAM tunic, a completely dark NAVY face and dark NAVY arms/leggings, one small amber square eye on the RIGHT side of the hood opening, short OCHRE scarf, simple brown boots. A SHORT ONE-HANDED SWORD extends from his right/front hand toward the RIGHT, slightly diagonally upward, with a simple ochre hilt and single light blade region. Do not point the sword to the left or behind him. On is about24 logical pixels tall excluding weapon reach. Keep the cream-hood silhouette clearly recognizable. No bell ornaments.
2. TORI: anthropomorphic orange FOX ranger, two large orange ears, short cream muzzle facing RIGHT, orange tail with cream tip curling behind to LEFT, TEAL short cloak over plain brown tunic. Holds a simple SHORT BOW forward to RIGHT, clearly separated from the torso with the bow hand gripping it. A tiny block quiver may show behind the shoulder, no detailed feather rows. Body around26logical pixels.
3. RINA: human mage, large PLUM/PURPLE pointed hat with broad stepped brim, CREAM robe with a simple purple hem, plain brown boots. Holds one short WOODEN STAFF forward to RIGHT, topped by a single MINT diamond. Hair is one flat brown mass, face is plain peach with one dark eye pixel. Body28logicalpixels, hat may reach32.
4. BARUN: broad muscular human barbarian, RUST RED short scarf and waist sash, simple brown leather vest/bracers, black flat hair, warm tan skin, dark brown boots. His large blunt-tipped steel GREATSWORD is gripped at the hilt in front and extends diagonally down to RIGHT. Broad shoulders and strong legs, about32logicalpixels tall. Keep one connected weapon only, no shield.
5. DOTO: short stocky DWARF blacksmith, large GOLDEN YELLOW beard drawn as two stepped blocks, BLUE work apron, cream shirt, brown boots. Carries a large simple dark IRON HAMMER at the RIGHT shoulder with a visible brown handle connected to one hand. About22–24logicalpixels tall, broad body. No beard strands and no metallic highlights.
Preserve the relative silhouette contrast: small hooded swordsman, long-eared fox archer, pointed-hat mage, broad taller barbarian, short bearded blacksmith. Friendly simple fantasy, not chubby baby dolls. Exactly five people, no monsters, no other characters. No bells or bell insignia anywhere.
The first image is TOO HIGH RESOLUTION: discard its detail, anatomy modeling, subtle shadows and small accessories. The second image's giant pixel blocks are the required look. If the faces or hands show details smaller than one big square pixel, simplify them further.
attempts.reason: 첫 생성은 몬스터 v2보다 크게 복잡하지 않지만 실제 레퍼런스보다 옷 명암·벨트·장식이 많아 재단순화.
